entries.note: full analysis in radar/notes/tanla-platforms.md and gbrain; not published

entries.name: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd.
entries.verdict: WAIT - peak-cycle GRM ($20.41 incl $3.82 inventory gain) at the market normal 4x; H1 CFO 25 Cr on 3,278 Cr PAT; 25-point score 16.5 with critical Fail on breakout

entries.name: L&T Technology Services Ltd.
entries.verdict: WAIT - 33.0x on continuing TTM EPS of 126.62 (not the 30x quoted), rupee revenue +12.1% but dollar +3.3%, profit +66.8% headline vs +19.6% continuing ex the 165 Cr Smart World gain, and a 30% month on 8-20% delivery against a 42% baseline; 25-point score 14.0 with critical Fails on volume, price action and delivery

entries.name: International Gemological Institute Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH, upgraded at the margin - 25.8x trailing / 22-24x forward on 43% profit growth, ARP +4% YoY and 42-46% delivery on the last three sessions, but the 420.60 high was rejected with 46% delivery behind the sellers and the 504 consensus target implies a 50% net margin never printed; 25-point score 20.0 with no critical fail

entries.name: Mastek Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH, not a buy - 10.6x TTM / 9.4x FY28E and net cash are real, but dollar revenue is falling (-0.8% Q2, -1.6% H1), margin broke to 14.4% and 12-month backlog fell 7.7% QoQ; screen added it at Rs 1,761.60, it closed Rs 1,458.30 (-17.2%); 25-point score 9.0 with critical Fails on price position, trend, base and breakout

entries.name: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH - 39.5x TTM / 36x FY27 on 34% revenue and 50% PAT growth, Rs 1,879 Cr order book and 42.8% delivery, but 4.1% below the Rs 2,190 ATH with the breakout unconfirmed; FY28 Rs 1,000 Cr EBITDA target implies only 15% EPS growth; 25-point score 21.0, balance gate the only fail

entries.name: Cemindia Projects Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH - 38.0x reported / 43.2x on core TTM ex one-off other income; parent (standalone) revenue +7.7% in H1 against 25% guidance and 53% of the order book from Adani; results day ran to 1414 and closed 1287 on 3.2x volume and 37.4% delivery; 25-point score 17.5 with a critical Fail on breakout

entries.name: Gabriel India Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH - 64.9x trailing (Rs 26,345 Cr on 19.16 Cr shares, not Screener 24,732) and about 107x on the parent operations alone after buying 28.99% of HL Mando and 30% of HL Klemove from the promoter for Rs 1,881 Cr of stock plus a Rs 1,000 Cr NCD; H1 EBITDA margin 8.7% vs 9.6%, PAT +9.4%, a third of pretax profit now associate income, three of seven gates fail; 25-point score 17.0 with a critical Fail on breakout

entries.name: Minda Corporation Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH - operating inflection real (Q2 rev +42.6% vs industry 18%, normalized PAT +69%, margin 11.8%) and cheapest P/E in the peer set at 38-39x normalized, but 4.3% under the 769 ATH with no breakout, 2.56% earnings yield vs 7.31% G-sec, and gates fail on ROCE-on-all-capital (12.7%) and gross D/E 0.58; 25-point score 19.5 with a critical fail on breakout confirmation

entries.name: Marksans Pharma Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH - 7 of 7 gates and the cheapest multiple in the peer set (25.0x vs industry 33.4x, ROCE 18.8% vs 14.9%) on record Q2 (revenue 940 Cr +30.5%, PAT 143.5 Cr +44.8%, UK/Europe +64.9% vs US +8.7%), but core P/E is 30.4x once 99 Cr of other income is stripped out, management has guided H2 gross margin down to 55-56% from 58.5%, and the stock is 11.9% below its high with no breakout; 25-point score 18.5 with a critical Fail on breakout confirmation

entries.name: Quess Corp Ltd.
entries.verdict: WATCH - 18.3x reported is ~24.9x on normalised 25.17% tax (3.3% FY26 rate disallowed, Deloitte qualified 4 quarters, 388 Cr contingent + 845 Cr of FY24-25 claims unassessed); Q2 PAT +44% on PBT +12.5%, two-thirds of it a deferred-tax credit; 24% ROCE on 465 Cr net cash and the first 21k net headcount adds in three quarters; 17.5/25 with a critical fail on breakout
